review: W68 saved AI part-memory source fingerprint semantics
scope: Read-only audit of immutable W53 canvas and Gen3 runtime1 helper snapshots. No live app, provider, native, server mutation, or PSD modification was performed.

fixture.path: SPB Chevy Truck Starting Example PSD.psd
fixture.nativeFingerprintMeaning: W53 canvas reports the committed fingerprint as SHA-256 of the layered composite payload text, not the PSD file bytes. The different values are expected because these digests cover different inputs.

oracle: Same source path, dimensions, flattened composite, and current owner proof across a new generation may restore and rebind to the new generation.
A changed flattened composite, dimensions, path, or current owner/mask proof must refuse restore.

If two PSD byte streams differ while producing the same returned composite and all current geometry/owner proofs remain equal, byte-level source ownership must not be represented as proven unless the byte digest participates in identity.
Uncommitted source and malformed/forged extra record fields must fail closed.

details: Executed the actual frozen canvas _spbFingerprintBytes/_spbFingerprintText functions in a VM using WebCrypto SHA-256.
Executed actual frozen spb-ai-part-memory saveRecord/prepareRestore functions: a valid same-composite source at generation 3 restored from generation 2 and rebound to generation 3.

Provided distinct synthetic raw-byte digests while holding the composite fingerprint constant; current saved-memory API accepted the restore because it has no raw-file digest field and receives no such value.
Changed composite digest, dimensions, zone ID, uncommitted source, and failed mask proof all refused restore.
Adding an unrecognized rawFingerprint field to the saved record was rejected by the strict record schema.
dynamicResults.limit: The different-byte/same-composite case is a synthetic contract counterexample, not a modified-PSD import or native reproduction. The test proves the current interface cannot distinguish that case when supplied current owner/mask proofs are otherwise equal; it does not prove a particular pair of PSD files actually has equal composites.

sourceEvidence.locations: importPSD sends only psd_path and thumbnail_size to /api/psd-import; around line 22105 it computes _spbFingerprintText(data.composite), and around line 22250 commits that fingerprint.
The /api/psd-import response includes dimensions, layers, composite, and psd_path; it has no source byte digest. Its response cache key uses path, mtime, and thumbnail size around line 122.

Persisted source schema at lines 98-105 contains only path, fingerprint, width, height; prepareRestore compares these and asks fresh owner/mask proofs. Generation is rebound at runtime and is not persisted.
currentSource reads committed path/fingerprint/generation and dimensions from the source transaction; it has no independent PSD-byte digest.

An existing _source_fingerprint helper streams a server-side SHA-256 in 1 MiB chunks, but it is used by saved-project source verification endpoints, not the generic /api/psd-import response or layered canvas transaction.

assessment: Current saved part-memory binds to flattened-composite identity, dimensions, path, generation-at-runtime, and fresh geometry/owner/mask proof. This is strong for visible source equivalence but cannot establish identity of the original PSD byte stream. A same-path PSD replacement that preserves its composite yet changes layer contents/metadata could retain the same composite fingerprint; if current ownership proofs also remain equal, this interface has no source-byte discriminator.
recommendation: Do not patch the helper alone: it cannot derive the digest from fields it never receives. Add a server-side streamed SHA-256 for the normalized import path to /api/psd-import (reuse the existing backend streaming pattern), return it as a distinct sourceBytesSha256 field, and include it in the PSD import response cache identity so same-path changes cannot receive stale identity. Bind the committed layered source transaction and persisted part-memory record to that digest while retaining a separate composite fingerprint for render/output checks. Do not send or duplicate the multi-megabyte PSD through the browser. On unavailable digest, refuse durable part-memory restore/save or retain only session-local composite semantics. This is a proposal for parent integration; no code changes were made.
